groups.label: Schedules outside the district calendar
items: As of August 13, 2026, OUSD’s transportation page does not list a separate 2027–28 registration deadline. Check the official page before relying on a prior-year deadline.
Bell schedules, minimum days, orientations, and school events should be checked on the individual school site or in ParentSquare.
Summer Learning and Expanded Learning programs publish schedules separately from the regular district calendar.
Enrollment deadlines and school assignments are separate from the academic calendar.

customSections.label: OUSD Calendar Types and Programs
customSections.content: Most OUSD students follow the district calendar, but some schools and programs use different schedules.

groups.label: When to check another calendar
items: Alternative education high schools may use different grading calendars.
Child Development Centers and early childhood programs may use different hours or remain open during some district breaks.
Independent study and adult education students should confirm program-specific dates.
Charter and independently operated schools in Oakland may publish calendars that do not follow OUSD district dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When does OUSD start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: OUSD students are scheduled to start the 2027–28 school year on Monday, August 9, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for OUSD in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of instruction for Oakland Unified is Wednesday, May 24, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is OUSD Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: OUSD Spring Break runs Monday, April 3 through Friday, April 7, 2028. Students return Monday, April 10.

calendarFaqs.q: When is OUSD Winter Break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 20–31, 2027. January 3 is a professional development day with no school for students, so classes resume Tuesday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: Which OUSD professional development days are no-school days in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: September 17, 2027 and January 3, 2028 are professional development days with no school for students. The spring semester begins January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the OUSD calendar apply to charter schools?
calendarFaqs.a: Not necessarily. Charter and independently operated schools in Oakland may publish their own calendars, so families should check the individual school calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all OUSD programs follow the same calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Alternative education, Child Development Centers, independent study, adult education, and other programs may use different schedules. Families should confirm dates directly with their school or program.
Yes. Check the official OUSD district calendar page and school communications before making fixed travel, childcare, or transportation plans.

content: The school year starts August 9, one day earlier than in 2026–27.
The last day is May 24, three days earlier than in 2026–27.
Cesar Chavez Day falls on March 31, immediately before Spring Break.
